items.title: The total tensor product of two K-flat complexes is K-flat
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma is a closure property for the K-flat complexes introduced earlier in the chapter: if K and L are K-flat complexes of modules over a ring, then the total complex of their tensor product is again K-flat (statement lines 14223-14227). The proof is nine lines (proof lines 14230-14238) and consists of the displayed associativity isomorphism between the total complexes of M tensor Tot(K tensor L) and of Tot(M tensor K) tensor L, together with the sentence that the result follows from this isomorphism and the definition. The content is therefore the observation that testing K-flatness of Tot(K tensor L) against an arbitrary complex M is the same as testing K-flatness of K against Tot(M tensor L) on one hand and that of L against Tot(M tensor K) on the other, which is exactly what the displayed isomorphism achieves. The verification of the isomorphism itself is not written out; the author cites it as the reason.
